2026-09-06.html: 第一种，也是我觉得目前最适合你的：不要硬转纯 Food Science，走 Materials / Processing，然后就业切食品工业。 Waikato 的 MEngPrac 仍然有 Materials and Processing，而且这个方向官方就把 food、dietary formulae、pharmaceuticals、metals、plastics 放在同一个 processing 框架里，职业出口还包括 Process Engineer、Product Developer。 你现在的经历正好可以接成：功能材料本科 → 宠物冻干研发助理 → 小样/试产/SOP → Materials & Processing Master → Food/Pet-food Process/NPD/Quality。这条比硬挤一个纯食品硕士自然很多。

2026-09-07.html:
IELTS Reading｜The Physics of Traffic Behavior

① 文章逻辑

Physics model → Chaos theory → Control → Criticism → Driver behaviour

A 气体模型应用于交通
B 小变化 → 大规模堵塞
C 精准控制车流
D 工程师质疑物理模型
E 司机行为 → shock wave → congestion

核心思想：

small fluctuation → larger disturbance → system-wide breakdown → congestion

② 核心 Chunks

take sth into account

考虑……

  • take traffic demand into account

  • take environmental impacts into account

  • take individual differences into account

Governments should take future traffic demand into account when planning new roads.

result in + n.

导致

  • result in congestion

  • result in higher costs

  • result in serious consequences

Heavy traffic may result in serious air pollution.

近义：
lead to / cause / contribute to

arise spontaneously

自发产生 / 自行出现

  • problems arise

  • conflicts arise

  • congestion arises spontaneously

Traffic congestion can arise spontaneously even without an accident.

arise – arose – arisen

well below / above

远低于 / 远高于

  • well below average

  • well below capacity

  • well above the limit

Traffic density was well below the road's maximum capacity.

这里 well = considerably / significantly

trigger + n.

触发 / 引发

  • trigger congestion

  • trigger a reaction

  • trigger a crisis

  • trigger a breakdown

A minor change in speed may trigger a serious traffic jam.

smooth out fluctuations

平抑 / 减少波动

Better traffic control can smooth out fluctuations in traffic flow.

搭配：

  • fluctuations in demand

  • fluctuations in prices

  • fluctuations in traffic flow

coincide with

与……同时发生 / 恰好吻合

The rise in traffic coincided with rapid population growth.

结构：

A coincides/coincided with B

be greeted with skepticism

受到质疑

The new theory was initially greeted with skepticism.

可替换：

  • face criticism

  • attract criticism

  • be questioned

relate to

与……相关

Traffic congestion is closely related to driver behaviour.

  • relate A to B

  • be related to sth

✅ related to
❌ related with

have less to do with A than with B

与其说与A有关，不如说与B有关

Traffic congestion may have less to do with road capacity than with poor traffic management.

高分作文结构。

limit the rate at which...

限制……发生的速度

Authorities can limit the rate at which vehicles enter a highway.

类似：

the rate at which cities expand

城市扩张的速度

interact with

与……相互作用

Driver behaviour interacts with road conditions to influence traffic flow.

搭配：

  • interact with the environment

  • interact with each other

  • social interaction

③ 核心单词

congestion /kənˈdʒestʃən/ n.

拥堵

  • traffic congestion

  • severe congestion

  • ease / reduce congestion

  • worsen congestion

Private cars can worsen traffic congestion.

simulate /ˈsɪmjuleɪt/ v.

模拟

  • simulate traffic flow

  • computer simulation n.

Researchers use computer models to simulate traffic movement.

fluctuation n.

波动

  • small fluctuations

  • price fluctuations

  • fluctuations in demand

Small fluctuations in speed can develop into serious congestion.

词族：

fluctuate v. → fluctuation n.

disturbance n.

扰动；干扰

  • minor disturbance

  • traffic disturbance

A small disturbance may spread through the entire traffic system.

breakdown n.

崩溃；故障

  • system breakdown

  • system-wide breakdown

  • communication breakdown

A minor disturbance may eventually cause a system-wide breakdown.

density n.

密度

  • traffic density

  • population density

  • high-density areas

Traffic density usually increases during rush hour.

词族：

dense adj. → density n.

capacity n.

容量；承载能力

  • road capacity

  • production capacity

  • maximum capacity

The road has reached its maximum capacity.

结构：

the capacity to do sth
= 做某事的能力

skepticism n.

怀疑态度

  • express skepticism

  • widespread skepticism

Experts expressed skepticism about the new model.

词族：

skeptical adj.

Some engineers remain skeptical about the theory.

synchronized adj.

同步的

  • synchronized traffic

  • synchronized movement

Vehicles gradually move at a synchronized speed.

psychology n.

心理 / 心理学

  • driver psychology

  • human psychology

Driver psychology may play an important role in traffic congestion.

aggressive adj.

激进的；攻击性的

  • aggressive drivers

  • aggressive behaviour

Aggressive drivers tend to change lanes more frequently.

brake v./n.

刹车

  • apply the brakes

  • brake suddenly

One driver braking suddenly can force others to slow down.

④ 重点句型

using + n.

通过使用……

Researchers analysed traffic using computer models.

≈ by using computer models

whereas

而；相比之下

Cars offer greater flexibility, whereas public transport is more environmentally friendly.

A，whereas B
→ 强对比

describe how + S + V

描述……如何……

The model describes how traffic congestion develops.

what + S + V

……的事物 / 数量

Traffic demand exceeded what the road could handle.

what the road could handle
≈ the amount that the road could handle

all it takes to do sth is...

要……只需要……

All it takes to trigger congestion is a small change in speed.

develop into

逐渐发展成

A small fluctuation may develop into a major traffic jam.

搭配：

  • develop into a serious problem

  • develop into a crisis

lead sb/sth to do

导致……做……

Heavy congestion may lead drivers to change lanes frequently.

注意：

lead to + 名词
lead sb to + 动词

⑤ 因果表达链

基础

A causes B.

IELTS 常用

A leads to B.
A results in B.
A contributes to B.

更高级

A triggers B.
A gives rise to B.
A develops into B.

例：

A small fluctuation in traffic speed may trigger a larger disturbance, eventually resulting in serious congestion.

结构：

A → trigger B → eventually result in C

⑥ 对比表达

whereas

A..., whereas B...

rather than

A rather than B

have less to do with A than with B

与其说A，不如说B

例：

Traffic congestion may have less to do with the number of cars than with the way drivers respond to changes in traffic flow.

⑦ 阅读题核心：Heading

不要看到一个词就选标题。

找：

Topic + Author's point

B段大量讲：

water vapour / dust / condensation

但它们只是 analogy。

真正主旨：

small changes → dramatic effects

所以：

Example ≠ Main idea

阅读时区分：

  • main claim 核心观点

  • example 例子

  • evidence 证据

  • comparison 类比

  • counterargument 反方观点

⑧ 全文最值得模仿的 5 句

1. Small fluctuations in traffic flow can develop into serious congestion.

小规模车流波动可能发展成严重拥堵。

2. A minor change in speed may trigger a system-wide breakdown.

微小车速变化可能引发整个系统崩溃。

3. Authorities should take traffic demand into account when designing transport systems.

政府设计交通系统时应该考虑交通需求。

4. Traffic congestion may have less to do with road capacity than with driver behaviour.

堵车与其说是道路容量问题，不如说是司机行为问题。

5. Driver behaviour can interact with road conditions, eventually resulting in severe congestion.

司机行为可能与道路条件相互作用，最终造成严重拥堵。

⑨ 一组串联记忆

traffic flow 交通流
→ fluctuation 波动
→ disturbance 扰动
→ trigger 引发
→ breakdown 崩溃
→ congestion 拥堵

一句串完：

Small fluctuations in traffic flow may trigger larger disturbances and eventually result in a system-wide breakdown and severe congestion.

⑩ 最小复习清单

Chunks

  • take sth into account

  • result in

  • arise spontaneously

  • well below

  • trigger a breakdown

  • smooth out fluctuations

  • coincide with

  • relate to

  • interact with

  • have less to do with A than with B

Words

  • congestion

  • simulate

  • fluctuation

  • disturbance

  • breakdown

  • density

  • capacity

  • skepticism

  • synchronized

  • aggressive

Structures

  • using + n.

  • A whereas B

  • describe how...

  • what S can handle

  • all it takes to... is...

  • the rate at which...

  • A triggers B, eventually resulting in C
